morningLede: Australia's land market is running two-speed and the gap widened overnight: the national sold base is up 10.7% in 30 days (10,069→11,147) with months-stock holding 13.5 into a 9% listings build — the pre-policy positioning footprint — yet NSW re-loosened again (15.3→15.7 months, actives 3,227→3,296) with Sydney South West now at 35.2 months despite honest pricing. Demand is arriving, but it is landing everywhere except the priciest basins.
note: House views written each morning by the desk analyst from last night's run. Income and build-cost figures are APPROXIMATE external benchmarks (label them as such, or verify current figures with web search). Land figures are from the certified RLP dataset.

houseViews.view: Maintained: the freeze is structural, not a pricing problem. Sydney South West is the proof — asking $2,200/m² vs $2,087 sold, a mere 5% gap, yet months-stock sits at 35.2 on just 263 annual sales: at $725k medians, honest pricing does not clear, only a price-level shift or demand shock does. Sydney Northwest stays the pure strike (33.6 months, only 197 of 580 listings priced, $2,420 asked vs $2,342 on the thin priced tail), Southwest holds a 39% ask-to-sold gap ($2,101 vs $1,515) at 29.5 months, and the state headline re-loosened 15.3→15.7 as actives built to 3,296.
houseViews.falsifier: Basin priced-share rising above 60% (Northwest especially) alongside corridor months-stock falling below 20 on rising sold counts, or NSW headline dropping back below 14 on stable listings.

houseViews.view: Maintained: VIC holds at 17.0 months as actives grind higher (6,585→6,648) — the only deep market still fully screenable (6,345 of 6,647 priced, 95%, at a $395k median). The ask-to-sold gap holds at ~17% ($844 vs $723/m²) and Melbourne North sits at 20.9 months on 487 sales, so vendors are still pricing hope, which delays absorption but doesn't break the mechanical case: cheap, abundant, priced stock is where the late-2026 investor rotation lands, taking it as volume rather than price.
houseViews.falsifier: VIC months-stock pushing past 20 with sold 12m rolling below ~4,000, ask-to-sold gap widening past 20%, or new-listing absorption failing to lift by Q1 2027.

houseViews.view: Maintained: the demand desert persists — Melbourne Peri-Urban 38.2 months on 126 annual sales, South Gippsland 32.0 on 103, Gippsland 26.2 on 66, West Gippsland 20.4 on 147. Ask-to-sold gaps of 13–23% ($576 vs $511 Peri-Urban, $629 vs $511 South Gippsland) stacked on no volume means these are markets without buyers, not overpriced markets: with fringe lots at $395k and 17 months of metro choice, the 644–772m² lifestyle lot has no scarcity premium. Avoid englobo and stage stock; this belt clears last.
houseViews.falsifier: Belt sold volumes rising 50%+ per window, or peri-urban months-stock falling below 25 without listings simply being withdrawn.

houseViews.market: Regional VIC hubs vs thin-print fallen angels (Ballarat/Bendigo/Darley)
houseViews.view: Maintained: trust the corridor, not the sub-10-sale suburb print. Today's top fallen angel is Darley at -48.2% last 12m — on 6 sales with lot sizes simultaneously up 124.5%, the cleanest mix artefact in the set — and the Bendigo suburb print (-29.3% on 8 sales, lots -29.9%) is the same noise. Meanwhile the corridors clear: Ballarat 484 annual sales at 9.5 months, Bendigo 301 at 9.6, both roughly half VIC's 17.0, at $315–325k the cheapest functioning volume markets in the state. Real regional weakness stays in low-volume satellites (Creswick -36.8% 3yr on 8 sales, Smythesdale -22.2% on 5).
houseViews.falsifier: Ballarat/Bendigo corridor months-stock rising above 14, or corridor sold $/m² printing negative on stable 250+ sale windows.

houseViews.view: Maintained: capitulation clears, holdouts don't. St Leonards remains the healthy version of the adjustment — -11.3% last 12m on 55 sales (up from 28 three years ago), genuine repricing that transacts — and Torquay's bottoming stays on track (-13.5% prior year decelerating to -5.9% on 43 sales vs 9 three years ago). San Remo is the holdout tell: the decline accelerated (-7.7% → -19.8%) with volume still thin at 15, meaning vendors haven't met the market and another leg down is likely. Cowes (-13.7% on 15) joins the watch-list on the same signature.
houseViews.falsifier: Torquay/St Leonards volumes falling back below ~15–20 per window, or price declines re-accelerating past -10% in the high-volume priced coastal names.

houseViews.view: Maintained with rising conviction: the 30-day footprint is now unambiguous — sold base up 10.7% (10,069→11,147) while months-stock fell 13.7→13.5 into a 9% listings build (11,497→12,535); absorption outrunning supply is early positioning ahead of the 1 Jul 2027 changes (negative gearing to new builds only, CGT discount replaced by indexation). The bid lands where product is priced and cheap — VIC at 95% priced and $395k, QLD corridors, SA — not Sydney basins where 66% of Northwest stock cannot be screened. Tight markets (SA 6.4, Adelaide North 5.4) take it as price; loose priced markets take it as volume.
houseViews.falsifier: No pickup in investor-share of land sales or VIC/QLD new-listing absorption by Q1 2027, or policy amendment before commencement.

houseViews.view: Maintained: still the tightest mainland market but the loosening trend is intact — 6.1→6.3→6.4 months over 30 days with actives 479→540 (+13%). Adelaide North remains a zero-negotiation market ($914 asking vs $910 sold at 5.4 months). The headline ~28% sold-$/m² growth stays composition-inflated (like-for-like ≈ +9.5%), and the $420k median is defended almost entirely via lot compression — Roseworthy -47% 3yr, Mount Barker -27.2%, Morphett Vale -32.6% — compression being the market's confession that the gross-price ceiling binds. Path remains deceleration, not correction.
houseViews.falsifier: Stock above 10 months, incentive share rising two runs in a row, or lot compression stalling while sales volumes fall.

houseViews.view: Maintained at high conviction: the blow-off signature is unchanged and complete — $/m² accelerated +52.2% then +96.3% to $1,027 (vs $344 three years ago) while lots compressed another 38% in a year and volume thinned 79→46→34 per window. A market that doubles its rate while shrinking the product a third on falling volume is borrowing from the ceiling, not raising it: at $1,027/m² the compressed lot still prints $400k+ gross in a market whose entire premise is sub-$450k affordability. Sell stage stock into this rate; do not underwrite englobo at these residuals.
houseViews.falsifier: Lot sizes stabilising while $/m² keeps rising on volume recovering above ~50 sales per window.

houseViews.view: Updated — the turn signal softened but did not clear: months-stock prints 8.1 today against yesterday's 8.2, still above the 7.9 base, with actives 607→753 (+24% in 30 days, fastest of any state) against a 20% forward-priced gap ($1,041 asked vs $867 sold) and only 69% of stock priced. This is one run toward the 'noise' side of our two-run falsifier — hold the caution, defer the escalation. The exhaustion prints persist: Mandurah +98.6% with lots -35.2% 3yr on thinning volume (40→33→22), Hilbert and Australind second-derivatives fading (59.3→27.8%, 53.4→43.3%), and the sell-out artefacts elsewhere (Greenbank +56.6% to $1,373/m² on 6 sales from 76; Virginia +72.9% on 8 from 48) remain unpriceable — treat any sub-15-sale window as noise against Mount Barker's real +64.6% on 89 sales.
houseViews.falsifier: WA months-stock printing below 8 on the next two runs (turn was noise, stand down), or breaching 10 (turn confirmed, escalate to underweight); Greenbank/Virginia volumes recovering above ~20 per window with $/m² holding.

houseViews.view: Maintained: the post-expansion base is confirmed holding — asking $478k→$479k, $/m² $710→$721, actives 1,056→1,071, months-stock 8.9→9.1 — the flat-lining expected once the 7-Jul universe expansion (948→1,022 suburbs) washed through. The underlying market remains the firmest large east-coast state: South Ripley +82% last 12m to $1,774/m² on a 33-sale window, Bahrs Scrub +53% to $1,319 on stable 16–23 sale windows. The $479k/9.1-month level is usable; the 30-day change series stays quarantined until August. One hygiene add: Blacks Beach (+125% last 12m, lots +59%, 6 sales) is a mix artefact, not a rocketship.
houseViews.falsifier: Like-for-like (pre-expansion suburb set) QLD asking or sold $/m² actually falling on the next monthly comparison, or the new base failing to hold ±3% over the next fortnight.

policyCalendar.event: Negative gearing restricted to NEW BUILDS only; CGT 50% discount replaced by indexation (new-build investors keep choice). Expected to rotate investor demand toward new land/dwellings from late 2026.
